title: A skip link or landmarks let you go past the navigation bar
note: no skip link; rotor lists the main landmark

title: All navigation bar items work with the keyboard
Search and all filters work with the keyboard
You can fill in and submit the registration form with the keyboard
note: course list and checkbox reachable with Tab

title: Course card buttons and table buttons (register / drop) work with the keyboard
The focus does not get stuck anywhere on the page
The focus order follows the visual order
note: profile: after Remove the focus is lost and goes back to the top of the page

title: The focus is always visible
The focused element is not hidden behind other content
The focus goes into the modal when it opens
note: register: after submit the focus stays on the page behind the modal, not in the modal

title: Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal while it is open
note: register: Tab goes through all page links behind the modal before it reaches the modal buttons; no focus trap

title: Esc and the close or cancel button close the modal
The focus goes back to the button that opened the modal
VoiceOver says that a dialog opened and reads its name
note: register: when the modal opens, VoiceOver stays on the "Confirm registration" button behind it and says nothing about a dialog

title: Each field has a visible label and VoiceOver reads it
note: VoiceOver reads each field label, type, "required" and the selected value

title: Required fields are marked with text or a symbol that is explained (not color only)
note: register: required fields have no asterisk or "required" text; only the Notes field says (optional)

title: An empty or wrong submit shows each error in text next to its field
note: only the browser bubble ("Select an item in the list"), one field at a time, no lasting text or highlight; decide at calibration

title: Each error message tells how to correct it
note: browser messages say what to do ("Select an item in the list", "Fill out this field"); decide at calibration

title: VoiceOver reads the errors after submit
note: after an empty submit the focus moves to the first required field and VoiceOver reads the browser message ("Fill out this field"), but not the field name

title: VoiceOver reads the result count after a search or filter change and the focus stays in place
note: catalog: "Showing 3 of 18 courses" is not read after the search for "data"; the count has no live region

title: VoiceOver reads the confirmation after you register or drop a course
note: register: "You are registered!" is not read (the focus stays behind the modal); profile: after Remove nothing is read and VoiceOver goes back to the top of the page

title: Each page or view has a title that tells what it is
note: each page has its own title (CampusFlow | Course Registration, Course Catalog | CampusFlow, Registration | CampusFlow, My Profile | CampusFlow)

title: Headings: one h1 per view and levels in a logical order
note: home: one h1 ("Find your next big idea."), then h2 and h3 in order

title: Landmarks: banner or header and navigation and main and footer
Link and button names tell what they do
note: home: 4 course card links all named "Register", with no course name; the same on other pages

title: Meaningful images and icons have a text alternative and decorative ones are hidden
note: no images; decorative icons are hidden; the icon-only Remove button has a name

title: VoiceOver reads the column header for each cell of the registered-courses table
note: profile: VoiceOver reads the column header when moving to another column

title: Dropdowns and toggles and tabs announce their role and state (for example expanded or selected)
note: dropdowns: VoiceOver reads role and state

title: The navigation bar tells which page is the current page
note: VoiceOver says "current page" on the menu item

title: At 320 px width there is no horizontal scroll and no content is lost
At 200% zoom all text is readable and nothing is cut off or on top of other content
Errors and status and selected filters are not shown by color only
Focus indicators and field borders have a contrast of at least 3:1
note: lowest 1.1:1 (computed from the CSS, not measured): fields have no border, only a #f5f3ff fill on white (1.1:1); field focus border #c9c1ff on white 1.67:1 plus a 10% purple glow; link focus ring rgba(91,75,255,.45) on white about 2.0:1

title: The needs-review contrast sample passes (4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text)
note: Needs-review sample (worst point of the background, measured by script in headless Chromium at 1280 px, not by hand): home "Browse the catalog" button white 14.7px/700 on purple gradient 4.22:1 (needs 4.5:1, fail); menu "Course catalog" #4a4568 on near-white 8.84:1 (pass); stat label "courses this term" white on dark purple 12.02:1 (pass) | Found by the reviewer outside the sample (profile, only after registering, so the automated tools did not see it): course code badges in the table are grey #6d6887 on the purple gradient, 1.18:1 (script; CSS .cell-course span sets the muted color); stat card icons are grey #6d6887 on colored tiles, 1.0-2.5:1 (computed from CSS), but they are decorative next to a text label, so not counted
